def _create_random_chromosome(self):
    # Intelligently generate a random chromosome to encourage exploration
    chromosome = {}

    # Use a normal distribution to choose parameters for better exploration
    base_channels_mean, base_channels_std = 32, 10
    n_blocks_mean, n_blocks_std = 2, 1
    dropout_prob_mean, dropout_prob_std = 0.2, 0.1
    fc_dropout_mean, fc_dropout_std = 0.3, 0.1
    lr_mean, lr_std = 0.002, 0.001
    momentum_mean, momentum_std = 0.9, 0.1

    for key, values in self.search_space.items():
        if key == "base_channels":
            value = int(abs(random.gauss(base_channels_mean, base_channels_std))) + 16
            value = min(max(value, 16), 64)
        elif key == "n_blocks":
            value = int(abs(random.gauss(n_blocks_mean, n_blocks_std))) + 1
            value = min(max(value, 2), 4)
        elif key == "dropout_prob":
            value = abs(random.gauss(dropout_prob_mean, dropout_prob_std))
            value = min(max(value, 0.05), 0.5)
        elif key == "fc_dropout":
            value = abs(random.gauss(fc_dropout_mean, fc_dropout_std))
            value = min(max(value, 0.05), 0.5)
        elif key == "lr":
            value = abs(random.gauss(lr_mean, lr_std))
            value = min(max(value, 0.001), 0.01)
        elif key == "momentum":
            value = abs(random.gauss(momentum_mean, momentum_std))
            value = min(max(value, 0.75), 0.98)
        else:
            value = random.choice(values)
        
        chromosome[key] = value

    return chromosome
